mapper.select: SELECT CP_ID ,CS_ID ,EVSE_ID ,SLOT_ST_CD ,OCPP_CONN_ST ,BAT_SN ,CUR_SOC ,CUR_SOH ,PROD_DT ,VENDOR_INFO ,CH_ST_DT ,EST_RDY_DT ,RSV_REQ_ID ,RSV_UNTIL_DT ,FLT_CD ,FLT_SINCE_DT ,LAST_EVT_TP ,LAST_EVT_DT ,REG_DT ,REG_ID ,UPD_DT ,UPD_ID FROM TB_BSSL001 WHERE CP_ID = #{cpId} AND CS_ID = #{csId} AND EVSE_ID = #{evseId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BSSL001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CHCP001 B ON A.CP_ID = B.CP_ID

SELECT A.SLOT_ST_CD AS slotState, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM TB_BSSL001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CHCP001 B ON A.CP_ID = B.CP_ID
GROUP BY A.SLOT_ST_CD

SELECT A.CP_ID ,A.CS_ID ,A.EVSE_ID ,A.SLOT_ST_CD ,A.OCPP_CONN_ST ,A.BAT_SN ,A.CUR_SOC ,A.CUR_SOH ,A.PROD_DT ,A.VENDOR_INFO ,A.CH_ST_DT ,A.EST_RDY_DT ,A.RSV_REQ_ID ,A.RSV_UNTIL_DT ,A.FLT_CD ,A.FLT_SINCE_DT ,A.LAST_EVT_TP ,A.LAST_EVT_DT ,A.REG_DT ,A.REG_ID ,A.UPD_DT ,A.UPD_ID ,B.CP_NM FROM TB_BSSL001 A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_CHCP001 B ON A.CP_ID = B.CP_ID
ORDER BY A.CP_ID, A.CS_ID, A.EVSE_ID LIMIT #{searchCond.pageItemSize} OFFSET #{searchCond.start}
